title:
THE REAL TRAGEDY
OF ABHIMANYU
text:
He knew how to get in.
He didn't know how to get out.
Arjuna had been drawn away. Drona formed the Chakravyuha, a spiral the Pandavas could not break.
Abhimanyu could break in, but not out. Yudhishthira asked him to open it, and promised the others would follow.
He broke through. Then Jayadratha held the gap, and no one could follow him in.
His bow broken. His chariot wrecked. His sword gone. He picked up a chariot wheel, and kept fighting.
The tragedy was never that he didn't know the way out.
accent:
He was never supposed
to be alone.
